C-IMPLEMENT-OPENWEARSYNC-END-TO-END.IntentSummary: Implement the entire runnable OpenWearSync watch and Windows product defined by the current approved GRACE context: shared Rust protocol/transfer/security core, Android JNI/Compose Wear integration, secure local Wi-Fi upload, durable Windows Rust receiver/SQLite, Kotlin Compose Desktop UI, realistic energy management, automated verification, CI and installable artifacts. The earlier baseline bundle is cancelled; validate current context before source writes. Only approved source and durable GRACE scopes may be written; preserve local work.

T-001.Title: Bootstrap final Rust and Kotlin multi-platform build without prototypes

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Create the Cargo workspace, Android JNI crate, Wear app, Kotlin Desktop app, Gradle wrapper/version catalog, shared build configuration, initial scripts/gates and Windows CI skeleton. Pin compatible toolchain versions in committed files.
Organize one final target repository; no disposable alternate clients or receivers. Define the project root tasks to build both shipping artifacts.
Ensure the baseline project can resolve dependencies and metadata on Windows with Android SDK and Rust toolchains installed.

T-002.Title: Implement Rust wire protocol and versioned cross-platform contracts

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Implement crates/protocol with typed manifest, capabilities, request/response, durable chunk descriptors, structured errors, protocol negotiation and strict size/range limits.
Freeze and test deterministic wire serialization and compatibility vectors; use bounded frames and reject malformed/untrusted metadata.
Document endpoint methods for status, transfer create/reconcile, idempotent chunk upload and commit.

T-003.Title: Implement shared Rust transfer engine, source integrity and resume state machine

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Implement cancellable streaming Rust sender/common core; bounded buffer; file version/manifest checks; chunk digests; local durable session identity; deterministic reconnect and acknowledgements.
Handle retries, duplicate/overlapping/out-of-order chunks, offset reconciliation, crash and cancellation without reading entire media files into memory.
Implement end-to-end integrity conditions that distinguish server-only hashes and source-verified content; enforce no source-file deletion.

T-004.Title: Implement audited cryptographic pairing and authenticated secure transport

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Implement user-authorized one-time code pairing with reviewed PAKE or equivalent offline-guessing resistance, endpoint key pinning, TLS validation, pairing revocation and secret storage interfaces.
Enforce a bounded online guessing rate, restricted allowed peer list, replay defense, zero insecure TLS bypass and no private keys in repository.
Prove unpaired or revoked clients cannot initiate transfers through attack-oriented host tests.

T-005.Title: Implement durable Windows SQLite transfer ledger and crash-safe file store

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Implement receiver file staging, consistent chunk journaling, durable fsync/checkpoint/ack ordering, read/write resource bounds and safe final filenames.
Use idempotent transfer identity and atomic final commit or documented safe fallback; reject duplicate completion, path traversal, disk full and stale source manifest.
Ensure a crash/reboot never yields acknowledged but lost data or a partial file falsely marked complete.

T-006.Title: Implement Windows Rust HTTPS receiver service and transfer protocol API

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Implement independently runnable, authenticated local LAN Rust HTTP(S) receiver with discovery advertisement, request limits and structured telemetry.
Expose status, session negotiation, ledger reconciliation, chunk receipt, complete and abort endpoints; handle concurrent sessions safely under explicit caps.
Bind only intended local interface/network policy and document Windows Firewall private-network configuration.

T-007.Title: Implement non-privileged Samsung Voice Recorder content discovery and readiness

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Implement Kotlin Android source adapter using supported MediaStore/content URI permissions and/or explicit user-granted provider access; support long large-file streaming descriptors and metadata.
Exclude changing/in-progress recordings, distinguish completed from unknown stability, handle revoked permissions and report no-access blocks instead of assuming ADB privileges.
Ship deterministic Kotlin tests with fake providers and explicit real-watch acceptance steps.

T-008.Title: Implement Wear OS Wi-Fi network acquisition, peer discovery and bounded selection

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Implement Kotlin ConnectivityManager Wi-Fi network acquisition and explicit binding for transfer sockets/DNS; verify native Rust transport cannot silently route over Bluetooth.
Implement time-bounded discovery via NSD/mDNS and fallback to saved/manual receiver address; ensure client isolation errors are diagnosed and not bypassed by manual IP.
Close callbacks/network requests promptly in normal and exceptional paths; allow Wi-Fi hotspot and normal LAN networks.

T-009.Title: Implement Android ARM64 Rust JNI bridge and safe lifecycle/cancellation interface

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Build Android NDK Rust cdylib for supported device ABI and package it into Wear APK; define stable handle-based JNI API for start, status, pause, cancel and cleanup.
Use OS-permitted file descriptors/content streams without private directory assumptions; enforce safe threading, JNI error mapping, cancellation and resource cleanup.
Implement mock-host tests for JNI boundary and native ABI packaging validation.

T-010.Title: Implement end-to-end Wear transfer orchestration and durable client resume

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Join file readiness, explicit Wi-Fi, Rust transfer core, secure pairing identity and receiver checkpoint API into one cancellable session owner.
Support manual Send New, per-file idempotency, error recovery, network reconnect, source changes, rejection and confirmation of final receiver commit.
Persist only bounded minimal client state; no forever background worker or unbounded retries.

T-011.Title: Implement paired-device discovery and enrollment UX endpoints

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Connect receiver pairing enrollment/revocation and bounded mDNS advertisement to Android scan/fallback controls.
Use accessible watch entry of a one-time code and trusted Windows confirmation; show fingerprint/identity mismatch and handle wrong/expired codes without weakening transport.
Verify a stranger on hotspot cannot trigger unsolicited upload, and changing peer IP does not change pinning.

T-012.Title: Implement round-screen Wear OS Compose UI and user controls

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Deliver Wear OS Material 3 home, recording eligibility, pairing, transfer progress, pause/cancel, failure and compact settings with circular-safe layout and accessibility.
Keep foreground user-invoked transfer visible and correctly managed on supported Wear OS versions; do not promise immediate background work.
Exercise navigation, configuration change, process stop/resume and permission denial tests.

T-013.Title: Implement energy policy, opt-in scheduling and lifecycle guarantees

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Encode IDLE, ELIGIBILITY, WIFI_ACQUIRE, DISCOVER, AUTHENTICATE, STREAM, VERIFY, CLEANUP states with enforced discovery and attempt timeouts.
No active idle socket, Wi-Fi Network request, wakelock, endless retry or continuous polling; scheduled work uses OS cooperative constraints with explicit user opt-in and battery/thermal stop policy.
Test every cancellation/timeout/success/error exit using fake lifecycle/network/thermal managers; expose trace markers for real device measurements.

T-014.Title: Implement Kotlin Compose Desktop UI and Windows service integration

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Implement receiver status, paired watches, enroll/revoke, destination folder, history, transfer progress, storage and firewall guidance and limited diagnostics export.
Keep Windows Rust listener alive as independently managed service when the UI closes if the user enables that mode, and support clean service shutdown.
Ensure credentials and recordings remain local and the UI never pretends failed writes were successful.

T-015.Title: Implement Rust/Kotlin cross-language protocol and security compatibility tests

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Provide deterministic protocol vectors shared between Rust and Kotlin/JNI, handshakes and invalid input tests, stable version negotiation and mispaired/unknown peer rejection.
Verify binary chunks and large simulated streams do not require unbounded JVM/native heap memory.
Supply scripts/gates/protocol-contract.ps1 as a leaf acceptance command with real failures propagated.

T-016.Title: Implement Windows crash, hostile-input and disk-pressure integration tests

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Test interrupted and repeated upload, corrupted hash, receiver crash/restart, journal durability, disk full, path traversal, forged ID, attempt flood limits and idempotent finalize.
Test no final file is published before integrity check and no duplicate completed result after replay.
Supply scripts/gates/receiver-integration.ps1 with bounded deterministic host tests.

T-017.Title: Run simulated complete end-to-end transfer under connection failures

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Orchestrate the actual Rust receiver and Kotlin/Android-adapter-equivalent sender path with fixture audio including greater-than-memory file sizes, checkpoint reconciliation, cancellation and reconnect.
Assert transmitted file bytes, full digest evidence, receiver durable final result, duplicate suppression and cleanup of every network/session resource.
Capture reproducible logs and report pending true-watch transport/recording access separately.

T-018.Title: Package installable Wear APK and Windows app, and configure CI gates

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Produce Android APK with bundled ABI-appropriate Rust library, Windows receiver executable and distributable Compose Desktop app, with reproducible build instructions.
Configure Windows/Android CI jobs that execute the Rust, contract, Kotlin and integration leaf gates, and save build artifacts without storing signing secrets.
No claim of production code signing without credentials; debug APK and testable Windows distribution are mandatory evidence.

T-019.Title: Provide real-watch and hotspot hardware acceptance harness with honest status

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Write repeatable field tests for unprivileged Samsung recording reads, both devices on S25 Ultra hotspot, station-to-station TCP, multicast fallback, Wi-Fi-only routing, large live upload and interrupted resume.
Provide battery/thermal baseline methodology with matched control sessions over eight hours and threshold evaluation; record actual traces and unknown firmware/OS versions.
Automate available ADB/logcat/perf capture without requiring root; if hardware missing or hotspot isolation blocks traffic, mark release gate PENDING/BLOCKED and never convert it to PASS.

T-020.Title: Update GRACE durable module contracts and verification projection from implemented source

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Update all nine M-* and five DF-* definitions in GD-MAIN with concrete code paths, ownership, dependencies, contracts and file-local START_MODULE_CONTRACT / START_CONTRACT / LINKS references.
Update corresponding V-M-* entries with real runnable gate tasks, test file paths, trace assertions and distinct hardware acceptance tiers; keep index routing valid.
All durable truth remains consistent with already approved user requirements, with no expansion to unsupported features.

T-021.Title: Complete code review and target evidence without prematurely applying GRACE

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Review security, battery, JNI safety, no unintended background activity, failure behavior and local repo drift. Run all five leaf target gate commands on a capable host and retain logs.
Run outer GRACE selected target and final assertions after project tests, reconcile scope/projections, and report skipped/blocked real-device tests honestly.
Do not silently mark spec/plan applied or archive change without separate user apply confirmation, and do not treat CI artifact creation as proof of real watch operation.
